name: Octavius Plantations Ltd
about: Incorporated in 1984, Octavius Plantations Ltd is in the business of producing and processing coffee and spices.[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1][2]
OPL is engaged in the trading and processing of agricultural produce and operates coffee plantations in Coorg, Karnataka, cultivating Arabica and Robusta varieties. The plantations are supported by modern curing and processing facilities. Its specialty coffee division offers a range of products, including green beans, roasted beans, filter coffee, and instant coffee blends.

pros: Stock is trading at 0.73 times its book value
Debtor days have improved from 38.1 to 22.3 days.
cons: Though the company is reporting repeated profits, it is not paying out dividend
Company has a low return on equity of 8.85% over last 3 years.
Company might be capitalizing the interest cost
Earnings include an other income of Rs.0.57 Cr.
